title: inqubomgomo yobumfihlo
html:
Le nqubomgomo isebenza kusukela mhla ziyi-15 kuNhlolanja 2026. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi lesi sitatimende sobumfihlo sizobuyekezwa ngezikhathi ezithile.

I-Kyber ibazisa ubumfihlo bakho futhi izibophezele ekuvikeleni imininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu. Le Nqubomgomo Yobumfihlo ichaza indlela esiqoqa ngayo, esiyisebenzisa ngayo nesiyivikela ngayo imininingwane yakho lapho uvakashela iwebhusayithi yethu.

Imininingwane esiyiqoqayo

  • Imininingwane Ekhomba Umuntu (PII): Njengegama lakho, ikheli lakho le-imeyili nenombolo yakho yocingo lapho ugcwalisa ifomu lokuxhumana nathi.
  • Imininingwane Engeyona Eyomuntu Siqu: Njengekheli lakho le-IP, uhlobo lwesiphequluli sakho namakhasi owavakashele, ngezinhloso zokuhlaziya.

Indlela esiyisebenzisa ngayo imininingwane yakho

  • Ukuhlinzeka nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zethu
  • Ukuphendula imibuzo noma izicelo zosizo
  • Ukwesekwa Kwamakhasimende : Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zamakhasimende nokwesekwa, okubandakanya ukuphendula imibuzo yakho, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthuthukisa okuhlangenwe nakho kwakho.
  • Ukumaketha Nokuxhumana Okuhlobene Nakho : Ukukwazisa ngezindaba eziphathelene ne-Kyber, ngeminikelo ekhethekile, noma ngemininingwane ejwayelekile mayelana nemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zethu, kodwa kuphela lapho unobudlelwano obukhona kakade nathi noma uvumile ngenye indlela ukuthola lokho kuxhumana. Unelungelo lokuzikhipha ekutholeni imiyalezo yokumaketha nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.

Ngeke siyisebenzise Imininingwane Yomuntu Siqu nganoma iyiphi inhloso engahambisani nezinhloso ezichazwe ngenhla ngaphandle kwemvume yakho.

Indlela esabelana ngayo ngemininingwane yakho

Sibazisa ubumfihlo bakho futhi siphatha Imininingwane Yakho Yomuntu Siqu ngokucophelela. Asiyidayisi futhi asiyiqashisi imininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu kubantu besithathu ukuze bayisebenzisele izinhloso zabo zokumaketha. Nokho, singase sabelane ngemininingwane ephathelene nawe ezimweni ezilandelayo, noma njengoba kuchazwe ngenye indlela kule Nqubomgomo Yobumfihlo:

  • Abahlinzeki Bezinsizakalo : Singase sabelane ngemininingwane yakho nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo nabalingani bangaphandle abenza izinsizakalo egameni lethu noma abasisiza ukuqhuba Insizakalo. Uhlu lwabo lungatholakala nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngokulucela ku-dpo@kyber.media.
  • Izinkampani Ezihlobene Nathi Nokuthengiselana Kwezinkampani : Singase sidalule imininingwane yakho ezinkampanini ezingaphansi kwethu, enkampanini engumzali noma kwezinye izinkampani ezihlobene nathi njengoba kudingeka ukuze imisebenzi yethu ihambe kahle (isibonelo, uma siqhuba amagatsha emazweni angaphandle). Uma kwenzeka ukuhlanganiswa kwezinkampani, ukuthengwa kwenkampani, uphenyo olunzulu oluphathelene noxhaso lwezimali, ukuhlelwa kabusha, ukuqothuka, ukuphathwa yimenenja eqokwe yinkantolo, ukudayiswa kwempahla yenkampani, noma okunye ukuthengiselana kwebhizinisi, Imininingwane Yakho Yomuntu Siqu ingase idluliselwe njengengxenye yalesosivumelwano. Sizokwazisa ngaphambi kokuba Imininingwane Yakho Yomuntu Siqu idluliselwe futhi ibe ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo yobumfihlo ehlukile.
  • Ukuthobela Umthetho : Singase sidalule Imininingwane Yakho Yomuntu Siqu uma siphoqwa ukwenza kanjalo ngumthetho noma ukuze siphendule izicelo ezisemthethweni eziqhamuka eziphathimandleni zikahulumeni (isb., umyalelo wenkantolo, isamaniso noma isicelo esisemthethweni sikahulumeni). Sizokwabelana kuphela ngemininingwane edingekayo futhi, lapho kuvunyelwe ngokomthetho, sizokwazisa ngalokho kudalulwa.
  • Ukuvikela Amalungelo Nokuphepha : Singase sidalule imininingwane uma sikholelwa ukuthi kuyadingeka noma kufanelekile ukuze kuvikelwe amalungelo, impahla noma ukuphepha kwe-Twenty, kwamakhasimende ethu, kwabasebenzi bethu noma kwabanye. Lokhu kubandakanya ukushintshana ngemininingwane nezinye izinkampani nezinhlangano ngezinhloso zokuvimbela ukukhwabanisa, ukuthola imiyalezo engafunwa noma izinhlelo ezinonya, noma ezinye izinhloso ezifanayo.

Ngaphandle kwezinhloso ezibalwe ngenhla, ngeke sidlulisele Imininingwane Yakho Yomuntu Siqu kunoma yimuphi umuntu wesithathu ngaphandle kokwazi kwakho, futhi asabelani ngemininingwane yomuntu siqu nabantu besithathu ukuze bayisebenzisele ukumaketha kwabo okuqondile. Uma kwenzeka kudingeka ukuthi sabelane ngemininingwane yakho ngendlela ehluke kakhulu, sizobuyekeza le Nqubomgomo Yobumfihlo futhi sikwazise njengoba kudingeka.
